text:
emily: dropped a short thread with screenshots for mobile/tablet behavior of the notify preview. main concern: layout collapse and tiny badges. link: https://redwood-internal/prototypes/notify-preview/mobile-v1 jonah: nice — first pass looks good. mobile row spacing is tight though. the channel name truncates at 10 chars and the badge backs into the overflow menu. priya: accessibility flag: when rows collapse into a accordion the accessible name should include channel + mute state, e.g., 'Slack #infra, muted'. currently screen reader only reads the channel name. marco: UX nit: on small screens the preview header eats too much vertical space. suggest change from two-line header to a single concise label: 'Who gets notified' and a small helper dot-button that opens details. emily: good call. Also noticed avatars are removed on mobile to save space; we could replace with single-letter presence initials for consistency. jonah: copy tweak: avoid 'Muted' pill on mobile because it looks like a tag; try inline suffix like '— muted' with lighter color. priya: keyboard nav on tablet: the accordion toggle isn't reachable with keyboard when swipe-to-expand is enabled. need to ensure focusable target and visible focus ring. emily: adding suggested aria snippet to the thread: ```
Who gets notified
``` marco: small animation request: when a channel is toggled off, animate opacity to 0.6 rather than hiding instantly — helps orientation. but ensure prefers-reduced-motion respected. priya: mention on color contrast: dark mode uses a blue pill for primary which falls below 4.5:1 with white text at 12px. either darken bg or use bold text. jonah: question: do we need to surface per-channel notification rules on mobile? folks sometimes want to confirm rule-specific templates. maybe a simple chevron to expand the channel row to show 'template variables' and 'fallback route'. emily: yes but keep it collapsed by default. show an ellipsis menu for 'view details' that expands an inline panel. prototype has that pattern at the bottom of each row. marco: interaction nit: the inline 'test notification' button on mobile feels heavy. convert to a single small icon button with tooltip. full text button can be in expanded view. emia: (typo) meant emily :D priya: also ensure the preview acknowledges team-level muting vs rule-level muting. language: 'Muted for this rule' vs 'Muted for this channel' matters — both should be announced to AT users. jonah: good point — let's use explicit language everywhere. design-bot: updated prototype (mobile) v1.1 published: https://redwood-internal/prototypes/notify-preview/mobile-v1.1 emily: i'll implement header condense, aria-expanded button, badge → inline suffix on small screens, reduce pill prominence, and animate toggle respecting reduce-motion. will post screenshots when ready. marco: lgtm. please leave a note in the release docs about mobile limitations (no full send simulation). priya: i'll run a quick a11y sweep after the update. emily: thanks all — quick iteration. :rocket:
